description: Vocabularies and per-kind defaults for the desired-state UI asset catalog. Domains organize; kinds carry dependency rank and select gates. Nothing here records what exists.

domains.description: Tokens, themes, recipes, providers, base styles, icon registry, and capability detection — the layer every other asset styles and composes against.
Reusable behavior primitives for state, async work, DOM measurement, interaction, and accessibility.
Scoped stores and global coordinators: layers, toasts, commands, background tasks, announcements, selection, and undo.
Layout, surface, typography, and small visual building blocks with no domain knowledge.
Presence, transition, and layout-animation primitives that render the kit's declared transition classes.
Interactive controls: buttons, toggles, sliders, steppers, toolbars, and pagination.
Fields, form coordination, validation presentation, and schema-driven form generation.
Floating and modal surfaces: popovers, tooltips, menus, dialogs, drawers, sheets, and command palettes.
Application shell, navigation surfaces, tabs, breadcrumbs, and structural layout.
Alerts, toasts, progress, async boundaries, and the empty, error, offline, and permission state compositions.
Lists, trees, tables, grids, filters, and collection presentation.
Charts and data-visualization families, lazily loaded and adapter-backed.
Galleries, players, viewers, and file preview surfaces.
Direct-manipulation interactions: drag, sort, resize, selection tools, and spatial canvases.
Agent-interface surfaces: conversation, streaming, tool activity, approvals, plans, artifacts, and citations.
Behavior-complete workflows that own state coordination, responsive behavior, async feedback, and recovery.
Controller-driven route-level surfaces that own their generic states and expose regions for domain content.
Reusable adversarial mock data that stands in for a data source so surfaces can be validated without a scenario.
Schema-to-UI compilers that emit configurations using the same public assets a human would use.
Ports to replaceable implementations: router, validation, icons, motion, positioning, virtualization, editors, storage, and telemetry.

gates.description: Strict compilation with exported public types, no accidental any, and a stable entrypoint.
Declared variants, modes, and parts match what the implementation actually exports.
Pure logic, state transitions, parsing, formatting, and edge cases.
Pointer, touch, keyboard, interruption, cancellation, nested use, and disabled behavior.
Semantics, naming, focus order, announcement, keyboard operation, and contrast, reconciled against captured evidence.
Behavior across the kit's baseline viewport matrix, including the declared responsive transformations.
Approved fixture matrix and screenshot regression coverage in light and dark.
Direction-aware layout, keyboard movement, gestures, icon direction, and transitions.
Reduced or disabled motion with no meaning lost and no broken lifecycle.
Usable presentation under operating-system high-contrast mode.
Long text, localization expansion, empty values, large values, many items, and overflow.
Bundle profile, render benchmark, interaction latency, layout stability, and listener cleanup.
Description, usage, API, behavior, accessibility, performance notes, and anti-patterns.
Named specimens covering every required state, authored as story contract data.
Works correctly with the shared managers, providers, tokens, and nested overlays it declares ports for.
The fixture supplies its declared data shapes and includes overflowing text, absent optional fields, at least one RTL string, a failure record where status is modeled, and a volume variant.
Every declared design ramp is present, spacing values stay on the approved grid, contrast pairs meet their floor, and component source does not bypass an available token.
Hooks and services clean up listeners and observers, abort superseded work, and access browser capabilities safely during SSR.
Replacement and codemod information when a public API changes or the asset is deprecated.

avoidVocabulary.description: Every item wrapped in an identical rounded rectangle, where alignment and typography would carry the structure better.
Whole page sections framed as floating cards, which DESIGN.md forbids in every kit.
A modal used for inspecting an item the user inspects constantly, where a contextual panel preserves position and flow.
Color applied decoratively rather than to carry status, selection, or hierarchy.
Gradient blobs, bokeh, or atmospheric backgrounds as default visual identity.
An action discoverable only on hover, unreachable on touch.
Background animation that draws attention away from live operational state.
A blocking failure recorded only in a transient toast the user can miss entirely.
An icon-only control whose meaning exists solely in the glyph.
